headline: Message someone from their name in a room

items.text: Click a message's sender, the name or the picture, to open their profile with Message, Mention, Ignore and the member actions.
Message on a profile opens your direct message with that person and creates it if there is none. No form to fill in.
Tap a message's sender, the name or the picture, to open their member sheet. Send message there takes you to your chat with them.
